series.name: 93E 15-80 kVA (3-phase online UPS, 380/400/415 V)
series.notes: The 93E 15-80 kVA manual publishes NO numeric A/F fault codes. It documents the MIMIC status-indicator LED table (Table 6-1), the system-event horn behaviour (para 6.2.2) and the typical status messages (Table 6-5). Actual per-alarm text lives in the Events/History log on the LCD and in the network card's alarm log, neither of which is published as a static table in this manual - see NEGATIVE. Do NOT assume the 9E A/F codes apply to a 93E. Same Table 6-1 wording is repeated in the Eaton 93E 300-500 kVA manual (https://www.eaton.com/content/dam/eaton/products/backup-power-ups-surge-it-power-distribution/au-products/eaton-93e/93E_300-500kVA_user_manual_EN.pdf), so it is treated as one family here. The same MIMIC panel is used across 93E / 93PM / 93PS, but only 93E is in scope for this KB.

title.ur: Normal mode - Green indicator chala hua

meaning.en: The UPS is in Normal mode and the power module is supplying power to the critical load.
meaning.ur: UPS Normal mode mein hai aur power module critical load ko power de raha hai.

causes.en: Normal operation - the inverter/rectifier is carrying the load at full protection.
causes.ur: Normal chalta hua - inverter/rectifier poori protection ke saath load carry kar raha hai.

causes.en: The unit was started in High-Efficiency (HE) normal mode, which is the documented default and still lights the Normal indicator.
causes.ur: Unit ko High-Efficiency (HE) normal mode mein start kiya gaya, jo manual ka default hai aur phir bhi Normal indicator jalata hai.

solutions.en: No action needed; record the load percent and battery runtime from the MIMIC screen for your log.
solutions.ur: Koi karam nahi; apni log ke liye MIMIC screen se load percent aur battery runtime likh lein.

solutions.en: If you plan maintenance, use the Controls menu to transfer to Bypass first rather than pulling a breaker.
solutions.ur: Agar maintenance ka plan hai to Controls menu se pehle Bypass par transfer karein, breaker kheenchne ke bajaye.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

meaning.en: The UPS is turned off; no status is being reported by the MIMIC panel.
meaning.ur: UPS band hai; MIMIC panel koi status nahi bata raha.

causes.en: The UPS was deliberately shut down by an operator for maintenance or a planned stop.
causes.ur: UPS ko operator ne jaanbujhkar maintenance ya planned stop ke liye band kiya.

causes.en: The UPS lost control power and shut itself down after an EPO or REPO event.
causes.ur: UPS ka control power chala gaya aur EPO ya REPO event ke baad khud band ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the History log and the REPO/EPO switch positions before assuming the unit is healthy.
solutions.ur: Unit healthy maan lene se pehle History log aur REPO/EPO switch ki position check karein.

solutions.en: If an EPO/REPO event caused it, find the reason before re-energising; the switch must be returned to normal.
solutions.ur: Agar EPO/REPO event ne kiya hai to dobara energize karne se pehle wajah dhoondein; switch normal par wapas hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Restart with the Controls menu (UPS -> LOAD OFF NORMAL), not by forcing the breakers, after normal mode is confirmed safe.
solutions.ur: Normal mode mehfoof hai ye confirm karne ke baad Controls menu se (UPS -> LOAD OFF NORMAL) restart karein, breakers zabardasti band na karayein.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.code: Battery mode (Yellow On, Normal stays On)
aliases: Battery mode (Yellow On, Normal stays On)

title.en: Battery mode (Yellow On, Green also On)
title.ur: Battery mode (Yellow On, Green bhi On)

meaning.en: The UPS is on battery. Because battery mode is a normal condition, the Normal indicator also stays illuminated - this is not a fault.
meaning.ur: UPS battery par hai. Kyunke battery mode aam halat hai, Normal indicator bhi jalta rehta hai - ye fault nahi hai.

causes.en: The utility supply has failed and the UPS is discharging the battery string.
causes.ur: Utility supply chala gaya hai aur UPS battery string discharge kar raha hai.

causes.en: The input is out of tolerance so the UPS has transferred to battery by design.
causes.ur: Input tolerance se bahar hai is liye UPS apni taraf se battery par chala gaya hai.

solutions.en: Read the battery runtime from the MIMIC screen and plan the load shutdown before time runs out.
solutions.ur: MIMIC screen se battery runtime parhein aur waqt khatam hone se pehle load shutdown ka plan banayein.

solutions.en: Check the upstream input breaker and the utility supply before assuming the battery is at fault.
solutions.ur: Battery ko fault samajhne se pehle upstream input breaker aur utility supply check karein.

solutions.en: On return of mains, confirm the unit returns to Normal mode and the charger restarts, then run a battery test.
solutions.ur: Mains wapas aane par confirm karein ke unit Normal mode wapas aa gaya aur charger chal pada, phir battery test chalayein.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Battery indicator On together with Green Normal indicator On; event horn cycles at a half-second rate

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

title.ur: Bypass mode - Yellow On, Green band

meaning.en: The UPS is in Bypass mode and the critical load is supported by the bypass source, so the load is not protected by the UPS.
meaning.ur: UPS Bypass mode mein hai aur critical load bypass source se chal raha hai, is liye load UPS se protected nahi hai.

causes.en: An operator transferred the UPS to Bypass mode from the Controls menu.
causes.ur: Operator ne Controls menu se UPS ko Bypass mode par transfer kiya.

causes.en: A fault or an overload forced the static switch into bypass to keep the load alive.
causes.ur: Koi fault ya overload static switch ko bypass par le gaya taake load zinda rahe.

causes.en: The bypass input is out of tolerance, so the unit cannot return to Normal.
causes.ur: Bypass input tolerance se bahar hai, is liye unit Normal par wapas nahi aa sakta.

solutions.en: Read the History log and the Events screen to find the alarm or command that put the unit into bypass.
solutions.ur: History log aur Events screen parhein taake pata chale kaunsa alarm ya command unit ko bypass par le gaya.

solutions.en: Measure the bypass input voltage and frequency at the bypass breaker with a DMM; both must be inside tolerance.
solutions.ur: DMM se bypass breaker par bypass input voltage aur frequency maarein; dono tolerance ke andar hone chahiye.

solutions.en: Transfer the load back to Normal via the Controls menu (Bypass -> Normal) and confirm the Green indicator returns.
solutions.ur: Controls menu se (Bypass -> Normal) load wapas Normal par transfer karein aur confirm karein ke Green indicator wapas aa gaya.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Bypass indicator On, Green Normal indicator not illuminated

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

title.ur: Active alarm - Yellow On aur horn

meaning.en: The UPS has an active alarm needing immediate attention. The LCD shows the highest-priority active alarms and the horn sounds.
meaning.ur: UPS par active alarm hai jis par foren tawajjo chahiye. LCD sabse pehle priority wale active alarm dikhata hai aur horn bajta hai.

causes.en: Any alarm, notice or command category event recorded in the Events log.
causes.ur: Events log mein likha gaya koi bhi alarm, notice ya command category event.

causes.en: The Alarm indicator may be illuminated along with the Normal, Battery or Bypass indicator, so read the LCD text too.
causes.ur: Alarm indicator Normal, Battery ya Bypass indicator ke saath bhi jal sakta hai, is liye LCD text bhi parhein.

solutions.en: Press any control panel pushbutton once to silence the horn, then read the alarm text in the LCD status area.
solutions.ur: Horn band karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein, phir LCD status area mein alarm text parhein.

solutions.en: Go to the Events screen and note every active alarm; the LCD shows the highest priority one only.
solutions.ur: Events screen par jaayein aur har active alarm likh lein; LCD sirf sabse badi priority wala dikhata hai.

solutions.en: Check the History log to see whether the alarm is clearing, recurring or escalating, before deciding on repair.
solutions.ur: Faisla karne se pehle History log parhein ke alarm clear ho raha hai, dobara aa raha hai ya barh raha hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Yellow Alarm indicator On (may light together with other indicators) plus audible horn; horn cycles at a half-second rate; press any control panel pushbutton once to silence

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

meaning.en: There is a new, not-yet-acknowledged UPS alarm condition. The indicator keeps flashing until an operator acknowledges it.
meaning.ur: UPS mein naya alarm hai jise abhi tak kisi operator ne acknowledge nahi kiya. Indicator tab tak flash karta rahega jab tak koi operator acknowledge na kare.

causes.en: A new alarm has just been raised and nobody has yet pressed a pushbutton to acknowledge it.
causes.ur: Naya alarm abhi uth hai aur abhi tak kisi ne acknowledge karne ke liye pushbutton nahi dabaya.

causes.en: A previously acknowledged alarm changed category and was re-raised as new.
causes.ur: Pehle acknowledge kiya hua alarm category badal kar naye roop mein dobara uth hai.

solutions.en: Press any control panel pushbutton once to acknowledge the alarm and stop the flashing.
solutions.ur: Flashing band karne ke liye control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein.

solutions.en: Immediately read the alarm text and the Events screen, because acknowledging hides the flashing but not the alarm.
solutions.ur: Foran alarm text aur Events screen parhein, kyunke acknowledge karne par flashing band hoti hai magar alarm nahi.

solutions.en: Do not clear the fault list until the root cause is found; clear it only after the repair is verified.
solutions.ur: Wajah dhoondne tak fault list clear na karein; sirf tabdeeli verify hone ke baad clear karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Red Alarm indicator flashing continuously until acknowledged by pressing any control panel pushbutton once

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

title.en: Output AC under voltage (MIMIC alarm text)
title.ur: Output AC kam hai (MIMIC alarm text)

meaning.en: Example MIMIC alarm text published in the manual: the output AC voltage is below the acceptable window, so the load is at risk.
meaning.ur: Manual mein diya gaya MIMIC alarm text ka misaal: output AC voltage ijazat se neeche hai, is liye load par khatra hai.

causes.en: The output voltage has dropped below the transfer window, e.g. after a load step or a bypass supply dip.
causes.ur: Output voltage transfer window se neeche gir gaya hai, maslan load step ya bypass supply dip ke baad.

causes.en: The critical load is drawing more current than the inverter can sustain at that voltage.
causes.ur: Critical load itna current kheench raha hai jitna inverter us voltage par bhar nahi sakta.

solutions.en: Acknowledge the alarm by pressing any control panel pushbutton once, then leave the load running if it is stable.
solutions.ur: Control panel ka koi bhi pushbutton aik baar dabayein taake alarm acknowledge ho, phir load chalta rahe dein agar stable hai.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage and frequency at the output breaker with a DMM and compare with the LCD readings.
solutions.ur: DMM se output breaker par output voltage aur frequency maarein aur LCD readings se tulna karein.

solutions.en: Measure the output current per phase with a clamp meter; if it is at the limit, reduce non-critical load.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se har phase ka output current maarein; agar limit par ho to non-critical load kam kar dein.

codes.blinkPattern: Alarm text appears in the LCD status area (top line blinks while scrolling); Red Alarm indicator flashes until acknowledged

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

codes.code: UPS: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE
aliases: UPS: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE

title.en: UPS status: Load Off / Bypass / Online, HE
title.ur: UPS ki halat: Load Off / Bypass / Online HE

meaning.en: The System Control screen's UPS status line. 'Load Off' de-energises the load, 'Bypass' feeds the load from bypass, 'Online, HE' means double conversion in high-efficiency mode.
meaning.ur: System Control screen ka UPS status line. 'Load Off' load ko de-energize kar deta hai, 'Bypass' load ko bypass se chalata hai, 'Online, HE' ka matlab high-efficiency mode mein double conversion.

causes.en: Normal operating states selected from the System Control screen, not faults.
causes.ur: System Control screen se chune gaye normal operating states, faults nahi.

causes.en: An operator ran a command such as LOAD OFF NORMAL, Bypass Mode or High-Efficiency (HE) Mode, which set the status text.
causes.ur: Operator ne LOAD OFF NORMAL, Bypass Mode ya High-Efficiency (HE) Mode jaisa command chalaya, jis se ye status text set hua.

solutions.en: Use the arrow pushbutton and RETURN to highlight and execute the command, entering the Level 1 password when prompted (default 1111).
solutions.ur: Command ko highlight aur execute karne ke liye arrow pushbutton aur RETURN use karein, prompt aane par Level 1 password dein (default 1111).

solutions.en: Confirm the result on the status indicators: Green alone for Online, Yellow for Bypass, all Off for Load Off.
solutions.ur: Status indicators se confirm karein: sirf Green Online ke liye, Yellow Bypass ke liye, sab Off Load Off ke liye.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

title.ur: Bypass ki halat: Off / On / Available

meaning.en: Bypass breaker/contact state shown on the System Control screen. 'Available' means the bypass path is ready to transfer to.
meaning.ur: System Control screen par bypass breaker/contact ki halat. 'Available' ka matlab hai ke bypass ka raasta transfer ke liye tayyar hai.

causes.en: Normal bypass path state; not a fault condition.
causes.ur: Bypass ka normal path state; ye fault condition nahi hai.

causes.en: The bypass feeder breaker was left open or closed by a previous maintenance job and has not been returned.
causes.ur: Bypass feeder breaker pichli maintenance mein chhoda ya band kiya gaya tha aur wapas nahi kiya gaya.

solutions.en: If the unit will not transfer to Normal, verify the bypass input voltage/frequency is within the manual's tolerance at the bypass breaker.
solutions.ur: Agar unit Normal par transfer nahi hota to check karein ke bypass breaker par bypass input voltage/frequency manual ki tolerance mein hai.

solutions.en: Read the alarm text before attempting a forced transfer; do not close the bypass breaker on a live UPS.
solutions.ur: Zabardasti transfer karne se pehle alarm text parhein; live UPS par bypass breaker band na karein.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00

meaning.en: Battery charger state on the System Control screen. 'Charger Resting' means the charger is off (field for rest), 'Charger' means it is charging.
meaning.ur: System Control screen par battery charger ki halat. 'Charger Resting' ka matlab charger band hai, 'Charger' ka matlab woh charge kar raha hai.

causes.en: The charger was switched off deliberately, or the UPS is on battery so charging is not possible.
causes.ur: Charger jaanbujhkar band kiya gaya, ya UPS battery par hai is liye charging mumkin nahi.

causes.en: The charger has been switched off automatically because the battery is already at its float voltage.
causes.ur: Battery pehle se hi float voltage par hai, is liye charger khud ba khud band kar diya gaya hai.

solutions.en: Use Battery Control Commands > Charger to turn the charger on and Resting to turn it off, then confirm the state on screen.
solutions.ur: Charger on karne ke liye Battery Control Commands > Charger aur off karne ke liye Resting use karein, phir screen par state confirm karein.

solutions.en: If the charger will not start, check the charger input supply and read the active alarm text on the Events screen.
solutions.ur: Agar charger start na ho to charger input supply check karein aur Events screen par active alarm text parhein.

source.title: Eaton 93E UPS 15-80 kVA (380/400/415 V) Installation and Operation Manual 614-01975-00
